notes: Read all 56 source lines with numbered output before editing; the file is pure platform-agnostic TypeScript utility/type logic (no DOM, browser, React, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI), so every export is ported faithfully and is fully React Native compatible.

L1 `import type { VehicleState } from '@/api/types'` -> type-only import from the already-ported native `../../../../api/types` (same relative depth the sibling index.ts barrel uses); identical VehicleState shape.

L2 `import { fmtInt } from '@/lib/numberFormat'` -> the native web-parity tree ships no numberFormat module, so following the established sibling convention (QuickStatsGrid.tsx/BatteryRangePanel.tsx inline the numberFormat helpers they need) `safeNumber` + `fmtInt` are inlined field-for-field. Web `fmtInt(v)` === `fmtNumber(v, 0)` === `safeNumber(v).toLocaleString(locale, {min/maxFractionDigits: 0})`; numberFormat's module-default global locale is 'en-US'. `durationStr` only ever formats `minutes % 60` (0-59) where no locale yields grouping separators, so the integer rendering is identical for every reachable input; the web fmtNumber try/catch only guards a user-supplied locale tag and is intentionally elided since the constant 'en-US' can never throw.

L3 `export { deriveVehicleStatus as deriveStatus, statusVariant } from '@/api/types'` -> re-exported verbatim from native `../../../../api/types`, which already exports both `deriveVehicleStatus` and `statusVariant`; the `deriveStatus` alias is preserved so the web file's exact public surface is kept.
L5-8 `StateResponse` interface ({ state: VehicleState; live: boolean }) ported verbatim.
L10-14 `batteryColor(level)` ported verbatim: >60 -> '#10b981', >25 -> '#f59e0b', else '#ef4444' (exact hex preserved).

L16-32 tire-pressure doc block + `TIRE_PRESSURE_PA` Object.freeze({ LOW_CRITICAL: 206_800, LOW_WARNING: 241_300, HIGH_WARNING: 310_300, HIGH_CRITICAL: 344_700 } as const) ported verbatim, numeric separators and all per-field JSDoc retained.
